answers.question: I was thinking about our previous conversation about data privacy and security. You mentioned that companies use two-factor authentication to enhance security. Can you remind me what kind of two-factor authentication methods you were referring to?
answers.gold: I mentioned biometric authentication or one-time passwords (OTP) as examples of two-factor authentication methods.
answers.answer:
1. SMS or text message codes
2. Email verification codes
3. Authentication apps (e.g., Google Authenticator, Authy)
4. Biometric authentication (e.g., fingerprint, facial recognition)
5. Hardware tokens (e.g., YubiKey)
answers.label: CORRECT
